rows.issue: Architecture admission architecture_generation_review_required; stage integrity stage_trace_accepted; scratch lineage scratch_lineage_clean.
rows.requiredEvidence: Keep architecture labelled review-ready until admission, stage trace and scratch lineage are all clean.

rows.issue: Component allocation allocation_ready; module engineering module_engineering_review_required; 0/9 modules pass; 5 modules still have critical sourcing blocks.
rows.requiredEvidence: Treat the architecture as review-ready until module review questions and critical sourcing blocks close.
acceptanceCriteria: No module has blocked allocation or unresolved critical sourcing blockers.
Every module review question is accepted, revised or explicitly deferred.

rows.issue: Interface verification interface_review_ready; 3/3 required interfaces have carriers; 0 accepted.
rows.requiredEvidence: Collect or accept interface-review evidence before calling the architecture fully frozen.
acceptanceCriteria: Every required interface has endpoint carriers and accepted reviewer evidence.

rows.issue: Requirement coverage coverage_review_ready; 1/1 requirements structurally ready or accepted; accepted ratio 0.
rows.requiredEvidence: Requirement coverage is structurally ready; collect accepted reviewer evidence before full freeze.
acceptanceCriteria: Every parsed requirement has architecture links and accepted verification evidence.

rows.issue: Pre-BoM engineering engineering_review_ready; 4/6 areas pass; calculations needing review 1; assumptions needing review 16.

acceptanceCriteria: Calculations, assumptions and verification activities are accepted or explicitly deferred.
